provenance: Byte-for-byte reuse of existing K-SAR research material prepared during 5-13 November 2026; no new OSM retrieval was performed for this copy.
timestampSemantics: The original waterways manifest records a workstation-generated preparation timestamp. OSMnx caching was enabled, so it does not prove a fresh Overpass download or exact OSM observation date. Original timestamps are retained without independent clock verification. The companion road-graph manifest timestamp applies to that earlier extract, not this waterway file.

limitations: Mapped water features, not an event inundation extent or historical 2024 snapshot.

companionRoadManifest.scope: Earlier road-network research context only; not the waterway acquisition timestamp.

preparation.processing: Intersection with the study bounding box; retain LineString, MultiLineString, Polygon and MultiPolygon geometries. Original feature-level OSM IDs and source URLs are preserved.

limitations: Mapped water features, not an event inundation extent or historical 2024 snapshot.
Mapped water geometry is contextual cartography, not radar-derived floodwater, live water level, navigability or verified hydraulic connectivity.
